# Ambica Travels (ambicatravels.in)

Taxi-service website: a home page plus one landing page per route (used as ad landing pages).

**Stack:** plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, generated by one small Node script (`build.mjs`, no packages),
served as static files by Caddy on the same VPS as VanixStore. No database and no running app process,
so pages load fast and there is nothing to crash.

## Change anything: edit `site.config.json`

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Phone, WhatsApp, email, address | top of the file |
| Routes (each one becomes a page like `/surat-to-vadodara-taxi/`) | `routes` |
| Fares per car on a route page | `routes[].fares`, e.g. `{ "Sedan": "from ₹3,500" }` |
| Cars, services | `cabs`, `services` |
| Google Tag Manager / GA4 / Google Ads / Meta Pixel IDs | `tracking` |

Brand colours are the six values at the top of `src/site.css`.

Push to `main` and the server publishes it within a minute.

## Run it locally

```bash
node build.mjs            # writes ./dist
npx serve dist            # or: cd dist && python3 -m http.server
```

## Tracking events (fire only when IDs are set)

| Event | When | Google Ads conversion label key |
|---|---|---|
| `call_click` | any phone link tapped | `googleAdsCallLabel` |
| `whatsapp_click` | any WhatsApp button tapped | `googleAdsWhatsappLabel` |
| `generate_lead` | "Send on WhatsApp" pressed after filling the booking form | `googleAdsLeadLabel` |

Meta Pixel receives `Contact` (call / WhatsApp) and `Lead` (form).

## Server (one time, as root on the VPS)

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NairutyaShah18/ambicatravels-/main/deploy/setup-server.sh | bash
```

This creates its own user (`ambica`) and folder (`/srv/ambicatravels`), adds an `ambicatravels.in` block to
Caddy without changing the VanixStore block, and installs a one-minute auto-update timer.
Point DNS `A` records for `ambicatravels.in` and `www` at the server IP first so Caddy can issue HTTPS.

## Before launch

- Replace the placeholder phone / WhatsApp numbers and the address (`node build.mjs` lists what is missing).
- Check route distances and times in `site.config.json`; they are approximate.
- Add the site to Google Search Console and submit `https://ambicatravels.in/sitemap.xml`.
- Create a Google Business Profile with the same name, address and phone as the site.
